pattern: fully planned split carries no group recommendation
experience: A planning agent split a card into two fully specified plans and the split gate had no recommended settings, so the human had to work out auto-build and the merge target themselves.
rule: Every child fully planned: recommend autoBuild true and 'own'.

pattern: epic breakdown recommends own branch and marks briefs as planned
experience: An epic broken into rough briefs landed every child in Ready as if it had an implementation plan, under an integration branch with auto-build on.
rule: An epic breakdown whose children still need planning: recommend autoBuild false and 'inherit', with those children planned: false.

pattern: nested split stacks a second integration branch
experience: A card already inside a group with its own integration branch split again and recommended another own branch, stacking a second integration review.
rule: If your card already sits inside a group that has its own branch, prefer 'inherit'.
